---
title: "ADFR tutorials"
---

| Tutorial | You will learn to |
|---|---|
| [Hello docking! Re-docking a ligand](tutorial-redocking.qmd) (PDB 4EK3 / 4EK4) | generate a target file, dock a ligand, read the output, and improve the run (exercise) |
| [Docking with flexible receptor side chains](tutorial-flexible-receptor.qmd) | compute maps for a pocket with flexible side chains and dock into it |
| [Docking a covalently bound ligand](tutorial-covalent.qmd) (PDB 3C9W) | set up and run covalent docking |

**Before you start:**

- [Download and install ADFRsuite 1.0](download.qmd).
- Put `ADFRsuite-1.0/bin` on your `PATH` (Linux or macOS shell).
- Download and unzip the [tutorial data](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/agfr/download/551/)
  (`ADFRsuite-1.0_tutorial_data.zip`).

To generate target files with the graphical interface instead of the command line, see the
[AutoGridFR tutorials](../agfr/index.qmd).
